name: VoidDrift
tagline: Phase between dimensions. Survive the void.
targetAudience: Casual browser gamers who want instant, no-install entertainment during breaks or downtime
Competitive arcade players motivated by global leaderboards and score-chasing across sessions
Web technology enthusiasts and Three.js developers interested in production-quality browser 3D
Indie game fans who appreciate distinctive visual aesthetics and games with a high skill ceiling
Vibe coding and AI-assisted development community members drawn to what the methodology produces
uniqueValue: VoidDrift is the only browser infinite runner built around a three-dimension-shifting mechanic. Unlike single-environment runners, players must simultaneously navigate obstacle geometry across Crimson, Cyan, and Violet dimensions — each with distinct hazard layouts — deciding in real time which dimensional plane to inhabit. The result is a skill ceiling far above typical browser runners combined with a global leaderboard to make every improvement meaningful.
keyFeatures: Three-dimension shifting: Crimson, Cyan, Violet — each with unique obstacle geometry and visual identity
Global leaderboard powered by Supabase — persistent competition across all players worldwide
Three.js 3D rendering running entirely client-side — no plugins, no download
Instant play: zero install, zero account required — share a URL and the game starts
Infinite procedural progression with increasing difficulty
Fully browser-native: works on any modern desktop or mobile browser
Built with vibe coding methodology — showcases what AI-assisted development delivers
pricingModel: Free to play. No microtransactions. No ads. VoidDrift is an engagement and brand awareness driver for Veridux Labs and a demonstration of the vibe coding methodology. Revenue is indirect through brand credibility and cross-promotion of Veridux Labs products.
competitiveAdvantages: Dimension-shifting mechanic is unique among browser infinite runners — no comparable free browser game offers three-plane obstacle navigation
Visual identity is immediately distinctive: crimson, cyan, and violet dimension palettes create a recognizable aesthetic no competitor shares
Supabase-powered global leaderboard delivers persistent competition that instant-play browser runners like Slope Game entirely lack
Three.js rendering quality exceeds the basic WebGL of popular competitors like Slope and Tunnel Rush
Zero friction entry — URL share converts directly to play session with no account, no store, no install
Cross-promotes vibe coding methodology, creating secondary audience from AI-assisted development community

crossPromotionTargets.rationale: VoidDrift was built using vibe coding. Direct call-to-action: 'Built with vibe coding — learn the methodology at vibe-coding.academy'
VoidDrift is a flagship brand engagement product. Every play session builds awareness for the Veridux Labs portfolio.
